results.text: Considering only orders with status 'delivered', list the product_category_name_english and the total price (summed across order_items) for that category, for the 5 categories with the highest total price.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    pct.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_price
FROM 
    olist.orders o
JOIN 
    olist.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN 
    olist.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
    olist.product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
WHERE 
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    pct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY 
    total_price DESC
LIMIT 5;
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, sum(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM olist.orders o JOIN olist.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN olist.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN olist.product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, t.product_category_name_english LIMIT 5

results.text: List the seller_state and the number of DISTINCT customers (by customer_id) who bought an item from a seller in that state, for the 5 states with the most distinct customers.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT s.seller_state, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS num_customers
FROM olist.orders o
JOIN olist.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN olist.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN olist.sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
GROUP BY s.seller_state
ORDER BY num_customers DESC
LIMIT 5;
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.seller_state, count(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS distinct_customers FROM olist.sellers s JOIN olist.order_items oi ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id JOIN olist.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC, s.seller_state LIMIT 5

results.text: A REPEAT CUSTOMER is a customer_unique_id that placed more than one order. List the customer_unique_id and the total number of order_items across ALL of that customer's orders, for the 5 repeat customers with the most total order_items.

    c.customer_unique_id,
    SUM(oi.order_item_id) AS total_order_items
FROM 
    olist.customers c
JOIN 
    olist.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN 
    olist.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_unique_id

    COUNT(o.order_id) > 1
ORDER BY

results.text: Using a window function, find the single highest-priced order_item in EACH product_category_name_english (partition by category, rank by price descending; if more than one item shares the highest price in a category, take the one with the LOWEST product_id). List the category, product_id and price for that top item, for the 5 categories whose top item has the highest price.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    pc.product_category_name_english,
    oi.product_id,
    oi.price
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        p.product_category_name,
        oi.product_id,
        oi.price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY oi.price DESC, oi.product_id ASC) as rn
     FROM 
        olist.order_items oi
        JOIN olist.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    ) t
JOIN 
    olist.product_category_name_translation pc ON t.product_category_name = pc.product_category_name
WHERE 
    t.rn = 1
ORDER BY 
    t.price DESC
LIMIT 5;
results.ground_truth_sql: WITH ranked AS (  SELECT t.product_category_name_english, oi.product_id, oi.price,         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY oi.price DESC, oi.product_id) AS rn  FROM olist.order_items oi JOIN olist.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id  JOIN olist.product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name) SELECT product_category_name_english, product_id, price FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY price DESC, product_category_name_english LIMIT 5

results.text: Using a window function, for each review_score (1 through 5) list the review_score, the count of reviews with that score, and the CUMULATIVE percentage of all reviews at or below that score, rounded to 2 decimal places. Order by review_score ascending.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    review_score,
    COUNT(*) AS review_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN review_score <= r.review_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY review_score ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / COUNT(*) OVER (), 2) AS cumulative_percentage
FROM 
    olist.order_reviews r
GROUP BY 
    review_score
ORDER BY 
    review_score;

results.text: Using a window function, find the single seller with the highest total order_item price (summed) within EACH seller_state (partition by state, rank by total price descending). List the seller_id, seller_state and that seller's total price, for the 5 states whose top seller has the highest total price.
results.generated_sql:
SELECT 
    s.seller_id, 
    s.seller_state, 
    total_price
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        s.seller_id, 
        s.seller_state, 
        SUM(oip.price) AS total_price,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.seller_state ORDER BY SUM(oip.price) DESC) as rn
     FROM 
        olist.order_items oip
     JOIN 
        olist.sellers s ON oip.seller_id = s.seller_id
     GROUP BY 
        s.seller_id, s.seller_state) subq
WHERE 
    subq.rn = 1
ORDER BY 
    subq.total_price DESC
LIMIT 5;

results.text: For each order, compute its TOTAL payment_value (the sum of all payment records for that order -- some orders have more than one). Using a window function, find the single order with the highest total payment_value within EACH customer_state (partition by state). List the order_id, customer_state and that total payment_value, for the 5 states whose top order has the highest total payment_value.

SELECT 
    o.order_id,
    c.customer_state,
    total_payment AS highest_total_payment_per_state
FROM (
    SELECT 
        op.order_id, 
        c.customer_state, 
        SUM(op.payment_value) OVER (PARTITION BY op.order_id) AS total_payment
    FROM 
        olist.order_payments op
    JOIN 
        olist.orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id

        c.customer_state
) subq
JOIN 
    olist.customers c ON subq.customer_state = c.customer_state
ORDER BY

LIMIT 5;
results.ground_truth_sql: WITH order_totals AS (  SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_state, sum(op.payment_value) AS total_payment  FROM olist.orders o JOIN olist.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id  JOIN olist.order_payments op ON op.order_id = o.order_id  GROUP BY o.order_id, c.customer_state), ranked AS (  SELECT order_id, customer_state, total_payment,         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_state ORDER BY total_payment DESC, order_id) AS rnk  FROM order_totals) SELECT order_id, customer_state, total_payment FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY total_payment DESC, customer_state LIMIT 5
